name: physical-deformz-android
description: Android (APK) wrapper for Physical.DeformZ: the game's single HTML file in a Capacitor WebView

scripts.android:sync: npm run web && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
